ValidationRule.description: Full Day requires an end datetime that is not before the start datetime.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Span_Type__c, "Full_Day"), NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date_Time__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date_Time__c)), End_Date_Time__c < Start_Date_Time__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Full Day end date cannot be before the start date.
